# daily-research

> An autonomous research feedback engine. Every morning at 05:00, macOS launchd runs Claude Code (`claude -p`) over three research lines: two repo-backed lines read the concept graph of each mapped research repository and pick external research that fills coverage gaps (coverage mode) or challenges/extends concepts once coverage saturates (frontier mode, steered by standing frontier questions); one free-exploration line hunts serendipity outside the saturated concept clusters. Reports go to an Obsidian vault. Two-pass pipeline (Opus theme selection → Sonnet research). Bash orchestration with prompt files; JSON/TOML parsing in stdlib python3 (no pip dependencies, no orchestration framework).

## Core documentation

- [Full AI Reference](llms-full.txt): self-contained project facts, Q&A, and glossary for AI agents — read this first

## Architecture

- [graph.jsonld schema](docs/graph-schema.md): node types, cluster naming, integrity rules
- [ADR-0001](docs/adr/0001-research-repo-feedback-engine.md): why tracks map to research repositories
- [ADR-0004](docs/adr/0004-line-restructuring-and-frontier-mode.md): line consolidation, frontier mode, free-exploration line with cluster repulsion
- [Theme selection prompt](prompts/theme-selection-prompt.md): Pass 1 (Opus) mode-driven theme selection (coverage / frontier / explore)
- [Research protocol](prompts/research-protocol.md): Pass 2 (Sonnet) research quality core
- [Main entry point](scripts/daily-research.sh): pipeline orchestration and fallback logic
- [Coverage report](scripts/coverage-report.sh): per-repo coverage classification and mode judgement injected into Pass 1

## Operations

- [RUNBOOK](docs/RUNBOOK.md): monitoring, troubleshooting, common issues
- [Contributor guide](docs/CONTRIB.md): testing, CLI flags, environment variables

## Data

- [graph.jsonld](graph.jsonld): concept cluster graph — schema.org JSON-LD research-history metadata; report nodes grouped into 7 broad concept clusters, updated incrementally by Pass 2 (query the file itself for live node counts)
